from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=["Solve the campsite puzzle carefully. Enforce all row/column counts, total tents, tree-tent adjacency, and no tent adjacency. Return a candidate final board wrapped in <begin_board> and <end_board>. Problem:\n{problem}"] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt="Compare all candidate boards below for the same campsite puzzle. Select or repair the board so that it satisfies every stated constraint exactly: total tents, row counts, column counts, each tree has one orthogonally adjacent tent, tents are not adjacent even diagonally, and trees remain unchanged. Output only the final board wrapped in <begin_board> and <end_board>.\nProblem:\n{problem}\nCandidates:\n{worker_outputs}",
        )
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=1,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.CAMPSITE_FINAL_FORMAT_PROMPT],
        )
        solution = await seq(f"Problem:\n{problem}\nDraft answer:\n{draft['response']}")
        return solution['response'], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
